info.name: BiziSmart - manually operated TotalVFD sandbox
info.description: Sandbox only. Read docs/15-totalvfd-sandbox-testing.md. Manually sign in, review each request, arm its case ID and click Send. Do not use Collection Runner, monitors or scheduled runs. AI-assisted preparation is not concealed. No production/POS integration or certification claim.
